topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I can’t help but think about the turn of events that led to this. I had everything planned to perfection, but somehow, the airline’s delay turned my plans upside down. I imagine how disappointed everyone must be, finding out I won’t be there. I know how important this event was, and now, I’m just stuck here, twiddling my thumbs while time ticks away. If only I could turn back the clock, I would do things differently, make sure to account for every possible delay. All I can do now is reach out and explain, hoping they understand that sometimes, no matter how much we plan, things just don’t go as expected.
